correctness.rationale: The final theorem is for precisely the F4 plane quintic of Asgarli–Duan–Lai Example 4.10 with a²+a+1=0, and its q=4 zeta numerator. Recomputed F_X=(a+1)X⁴+X²Y²+X²YZ+X²Z²+Y⁴+Y²Z²+Z⁴, F_Y=Z(X³+Z³), F_Z=Y(X³+Y³). Their simultaneous projective zeros must be among 16 points defined over F4: one [1:0:0], three [x:1:0], twelve [x:y:1]. Independent F4 arithmetic excludes all, establishing geometric smoothness and genus g=6. On Z=1 the equation is an F2-linearized polynomial in Y with coefficients depending on X; independent exact polynomial-basis field arithmetic and rank-of-linear-map counts give N1..N7=(5,35,65,395,1025,3395,16385). For m=1..6, p_m=4^m+1−N_m=(0,−18,0,−138,0,702). Newton identities produce c_0..c_6=(1,0,9,0,75,0,315), and functional equation c_{12−i}=4^{6−i} c_i completes L_C(T)=(1+3T²+16T⁴)^3. Degree-six mod-2 L implies full p-rank 6 and ordinarity; P(U)=U⁴+3U²+16 is irreducible over Q and ordinary, so standard Honda–Tate/Tate produce J~A³ with A a simple ordinary surface. Under F16 base change P maps to (U²+3U+16)², hence J~E⁶ with trace −3. Opposite-sign roots imply N_{odd}=4^n+1; for n=2k the squared roots give recurrence s0=2,s1=−3,s_k=−3s_{k−1}−16s_{k−2} and N_{2k}=16^k+1−6s_k. Isogeny is not polarized isomorphism. Exact finite checks corroborate the analytic derivation; no finite enumeration is misrepresented as an all-n proof.

value.rationale: The special curve is an established geometrically natural Frobenius-nonclassical plane quintic, not an arbitrary sampled coefficient choice. Determining its exact zeta numerator and ordinarity identifies a concrete genus-six Jacobian as a third power of a simple abelian surface over F4 and a sixth power of an ordinary elliptic curve over F16; the all-odd-extension vanishing Frobenius trace and even-extension recurrence are nontrivial structural arithmetic consequences. The exact invariant of this named curve is independently useful in future arithmetic, point-count, isogeny and special-geometry comparisons. Classical Newton and Honda–Tate steps are appropriately credited, and no larger family classification or external certification is claimed.
